purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Akbarpur

queries.query: Akbarpur Ambedkar Nagar Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records Bhulekh BhuNaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh land-record portal, the official BhuNaksha cadastral map viewer, the Uttar Pradesh digitization dashboard, and the Ambedkarnagar district Bhulekh service page. The dashboard lists Ambedkarnagar/Akbarpur and reports linked Bhunaksha coverage at tehsil scope, but does not itself provide parcel geometry.

queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery confirmed the Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council Bhulekh service and official BhuNaksha viewer. The current viewer exposed Ambedkarnagar (178), Akbarpur (00910), and Hindi village selections; no safe parcel polygon response was obtained for the urban locality during this bounded attempt.

officialSources.observation: Official Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council portal describes online land records and links to plot/map status services.
Current first-party BhuNaksha viewer loaded and exposed district, tehsil, village, and plot-map controls; current page displayed the public map service and disclaimers.
Official digitization dashboard lists Ambedkarnagar/Akbarpur with 339 revenue villages and 311 linked/geo-referenced villages in the observed report.
Official district page directs users to the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh service for Bhulekh/Khatauni.

200; current JavaScript inspected. Public routes observed included masterdata/levelvalue, MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, MapInfo/getPlotByPlotNo, and v1/khasramap/plot.
200; level 2 with parent code 178 returned Akbarpur tehsil code 00910.

200; bounded requests for 09,178,00910,216496 and 09,178,00910,216489 returned zero extents and gisCode 0917800910; no geometry.

uncertainty: The WUP point is in Akbarpur city, while the official service hierarchy is district/tehsil/village; municipal-city boundary correspondence was not established.

The urban candidate village records observed in the current service reported no map data and the bounded map extent was zero; this may reflect service coverage or selection limitations, not citywide absence.
No parcel polygon, native parcel identity, or CRS was returned in the bounded attempts, so no GeoJSON sample is retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
